title: Contribute a harness to the supported suite
statement: As a harness author or integration contributor, I can contribute my harness integration through a pull request so that other consumers can select it from the Cordyceps supported suite.

acceptance_criteria.statement: A contributor can submit the harness definition and any required integration support through a documented pull-request path.
After the contribution is accepted and released, consumers can select that harness from the bundled suite and use its supplied setup definition.
